result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal crossing infrastructure at a wide intersection adjacent to an industrial utility site. While sidewalks are present, the absence of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals creates a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide intersection without any painted markings to alert drivers or define a path.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Control
hazards.description: No signals or stop signs are visible to manage vehicle-pedestrian conflicts at this junction.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, paved sidewalk separated from the roadway, but it is obstructed by a historical marker pole. There is a lack of visible crossing infrastructure or signage to support safe access to the adjacent park.

hazards.name: Signage Obstruction
hazards.description: A historical marker pole is located in the center of the sidewalk, creating a physical barrier.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at a park entrance increases risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Clear Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Relocate the historical marker to the side of the walkway to ensure an unobstructed path for all users, including those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian warning signs to improve driver awareness and pedestrian safety.

result.summary: The image shows a spacious pedestrian plaza within a park, centered around a monument and surrounded by mature trees. The area is well-separated from nearby vehicular parking by bollards and grass, providing a safe and comfortable environment for walking.

hazards.name: Potential vehicle encroachment
hazards.description: The transition between the pedestrian area and the parking lot is only partially protected by bollards, which could allow vehicles to enter the plaza.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side background where the paved area meets the parking lot

interventions.title: Enhanced Perimeter Protection
interventions.description: Install additional bollards or planters to more clearly define and protect the pedestrian space from the adjacent parking area.

result.summary: The environment features a continuous sidewalk adjacent to a green space, but lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The roadway is wide and unmarked, which may lead to higher vehicle speeds and increased risk for pedestrians attempting to cross to the park.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked roadway without priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the side path meets the main road.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large black trash bag is placed on the sidewalk, partially blocking the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image on the sidewalk near the tree.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness at the park entrance.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the crossing point to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add signage to alert drivers of the potential for pedestrians crossing to and from the park area.
